category: other: navigation stopped ~1.4 m short of the cup; straw put down and fiddled with there
what_happened: Layout 7, red-white bendy Straw008, GlassCup021. Stage 0 at 193. Straw grasped 316-329, lifted 0.58 m. The base drove to the dining island and stopped at ~640 at its near corner; the agent view is unchanged from 640 to 1696, so the base never moved again. The cup was ~1.4 m away along the counter (visible in the wrist view at 1300-1400). The arm lowered the straw onto the counter and released it at 891 (1.39 m from the cup), re-grasped it 954-971 (lift 2 cm) and 1001-1555 (lift 0.39 m), released at 1555, touched it again 1566-1615 and left it on the counter 1.15 m from the cup.
causal_chain: base stopped at the wrong end of the dining counter (~640, 1.4 m from the cup) -> arm tried to 'place' the straw on the bare counter (891) -> repeated re-grasps 954-1615 without moving the base -> timeout
self_recovery: Re-grasped the straw three times (954, 1001, 1566) but never moved the base toward the cup.
uncertain_about: Why the base stopped there; the cup is small and transparent and may not have been salient in the agent view from the robot's approach direction.
